## 3. Frontend architecture decisions (with file evidence)

- **App Router, minimal static shell.** `app/layout.tsx:14` is a server component rendering a static `<html>` shell; `app/page.tsx:2` is a static placeholder ("Sign-in is Stage 1"). [evidence]
- **Single client boundary.** `app/providers.tsx:10-12` is `"use client"`, one `QueryClient` per tab via `useState(createQueryClient)`. [evidence]
- **Handwritten relative-path API client.** `lib/api/client.ts:8` `API_BASE_PATH = "/api/v1"`; `apiPath()` percent-encodes each segment and rejects `""`/`"."`/`".."` (`client.ts:54-69`); `buildUrl()` rejects non-`apiPath` paths, `//`, `?`, `#` (`client.ts:72-84`). 401 triggers one renewal + one retry, never for `anonymous` requests (`client.ts:116-124`). [evidence]
- **Typed errors.** `lib/api/errors.ts` maps status→kind and parses the server envelope into stable fields; deliberately does not invent a code when no envelope exists (`errors.ts:119-137`). [evidence]
- **In-memory session.** `lib/auth/session.ts:26-58` keeps the access token in a closure; `state()` never contains the token (verified by `session.test.ts:14-27`). [evidence]
- **Refresh + tab coordination.** `lib/auth/refresh.ts:62-128` single-flight per tab, Web Lock `sentinel-auth-refresh` across tabs, BroadcastChannel `sentinel-auth`, and "no Web Locks ⇒ never refresh" (`refresh.ts:110-112`). [evidence]
- **TanStack Query policy.** `lib/api/query-client.ts:35-48`: retry only network/5xx/429, 4 attempts, backoff 5/10/20/40 s capped 60 s, `refetchIntervalInBackground:false`, `refetchOnWindowFocus:true`, mutations never retried. [evidence]
- **Stack pins** (`package.json:18-39`): Next 16.3.8, React 19.3.0, TS 6.0.3, Tailwind 4.3.3, TanStack Query 5.104.1, Vitest 5.0.3, Playwright 1.63.0, MSW 3.0.2. Installed versions in `node_modules` **match every declared pin exactly** [evidence, `package.json` vs `node_modules/<pkg>/package.json`].
- **pnpm supply-chain hardening.** `pnpm-workspace.yaml:4-12`: `engineStrict: true`, `saveExact: true`, `allowBuilds: unrs-resolver: false`. [evidence]

## 4. Security decisions (API proxy, auth/session, env, secrets)

- **Dev-only same-origin rewrite; production is not a proxy/BFF.** `next.config.ts:11-16`: `apiRewrites` returns the `/api/v1/*` → `http://127.0.0.1:8080` rewrite **only** when `NODE_ENV === "development"`, else `[]` (`next.config.ts:12-14`). `DEV_API_ORIGIN` is hardcoded to loopback. Production leaves `/api/v1` to the described reverse proxy. [evidence]
- **Token handling.** Access token: memory only; refresh token: HttpOnly cookie (client comment `session.ts:1-5`, `types.ts:36`); refresh request sets `credentials:"same-origin"`, `cache:"no-store"` and `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` as the CSRF requirement (`refresh.ts:136-144`). [evidence]
- **No browser storage / cookie / console in app code, enforced two ways.** ESLint: `no-console: error` and `no-restricted-globals`/`no-restricted-properties` banning `localStorage`/`sessionStorage`/`document.cookie` (`eslint.config.mjs:14-30`). Static test `test/security.test.ts:40-52` re-scans `app|components|features|lib` for storage/cookie/console and absolute URLs. [evidence]
- **No internal API fields typed.** `types.ts` intentionally omits worker lease/heartbeat/error snapshots [claim in comment], enforced by `security.test.ts:54-59`. [evidence for the test; claim for the omission list]
- **Response hardening.** `next.config.ts:19` `poweredByHeader: false`. [evidence]
- **`agentRules: false`** (`next.config.ts:23`) is intended to stop `next dev` writing `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`. This option is not verified against Next 16 docs — [claim].
- **Secrets:** none committed; no `.env*` under `apps/web` [evidence]; root `.gitignore` excludes `.env`/`*.key`/`*.pem` [evidence].
- **CI least privilege:** `.github/workflows/frontend.yml:17-18` `permissions: contents: read`; pins Node via `.nvmrc` and pnpm via `packageManager`. [evidence]

Residual considerations (not defects, for the record): the BroadcastChannel carries the access token between same-origin tabs (`refresh.ts:100`); any same-origin script could read it regardless, so this is consistent with the same-origin trust model. The dev rewrite target is compile-time loopback only.

+
+Every dependency is pinned exactly (`saveExact`), and `pnpm-lock.yaml` is committed. Install scripts are denied unless `pnpm-workspace.yaml` approves them (`allowBuilds`).
+
+### Structure
+
+```text
+apps/web/
+  app/          routes and composition (App Router); layout and static pages are server components
+  features/     domain components and hooks: auth, projects, assets, scopes, scans, findings,
+                analyses, reports, audit-logs, settings (empty until their stage)
+  components/   generic UI without domain knowledge
+  lib/api/      client.ts, errors.ts, types.ts, query-client.ts, resources/
+  lib/auth/     session.ts (in-memory session), refresh.ts (renewal and tab coordination)
+  test/         MSW server and static security checks
+  e2e/          Playwright browser tests
+```
+
+### Same origin
+
+The browser only ever calls the relative path `/api/v1`. In production the reverse proxy routes `/api/v1/*` to the Go API and everything else to Next.js, under one HTTPS origin. In development the Next.js dev server forwards `/api/v1/*` to `http://127.0.0.1:8080` with a rewrite that exists only when `NODE_ENV=development`. The API grants no CORS and Next.js is never a proxy or BFF in production.
+
+### Server and client components
+
+Authenticated data is fetched in the browser: the access token exists only in browser memory and the refresh cookie is scoped to `/api/v1/auth`, so a server component can never hold credentials. Server components are used for the static shell, layout and non-authenticated static content only. `app/providers.tsx` is the client boundary (one `QueryClient` per tab).
+
+### API client and types
+
+`lib/api/client.ts` is a handwritten `fetch` client: relative `/api/v1` paths built from encoded segments (`apiPath`), queries through `URLSearchParams`, `AbortSignal`, `credentials: "same-origin"`, the Bearer token from an injected token source, and no logging. A 401 asks the token source to renew once and the original request is retried at most once; an anonymous request never renews. Failures become a typed `ApiError` (`kind`, `status`, `code`, `requestId`, `details`, `retryAfterMs`) read from the API error envelope; the server's message is kept for diagnostics only and is never UI copy, and no error code is invented when there is no envelope.
+
+`lib/api/types.ts` holds handwritten types matching the backend contract, with every nullable field typed `| null`. They are not generated from `docs/api/openapi.yaml`, which declares OpenAPI 3.1 but marks nullable fields with the 3.0 `nullable: true` keyword; correcting that is a separate API-contract follow-up. Fields the API never returns (worker lease, heartbeat, stored error message, snapshots) are not declared.
+
+### Authentication foundation
+
+`lib/auth/session.ts` keeps the access token in a closure, never in browser storage and never in the state snapshot given to React. `lib/auth/refresh.ts` renews it: concurrent renewals in a tab share one refresh; across tabs a refresh runs only while holding the Web Lock `sentinel-auth-refresh`, so no two refreshes of the shared refresh cookie are ever in flight (the backend revokes a rotated session and revokes the whole lineage on reuse); the refreshing tab publishes the new token, and any logout or lost session, on the BroadcastChannel `sentinel-auth`. Without Web Locks nothing is refreshed and the session expires. The refresh request is `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` with `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest`, the cookie travelling only as an HttpOnly cookie. Login, the boot-time session restore and protected routes are Stage 1.
+
+### Data fetching
+
+TanStack Query, with defaults in `lib/api/query-client.ts`: network and 5xx failures retry after 5s, 10s, 20s and 40s (±20% jitter, at most 60s), a 429 after its `Retry-After`, nothing else; queries do not poll in a hidden tab and refetch once when it is visible again; mutations are not retried. Scan polling intervals (5s for a running scan, 10s for the first page of a list with running scans) are applied in Stage 6.
+
+### Lint and security checks
+
+ESLint forbids `console`, `localStorage`, `sessionStorage` and `document.cookie` in application code. `test/security.test.ts` checks the browser sources for storage, cookie and console use and for absolute URLs, checks that the API types declare no internal field, and that the `/api/v1` rewrite exists only in development.
+
+### Stages
+
+Stage 0 (this foundation) precedes Stage 1 Authentication, Stage 2 Project Dashboard, Stage 3 Project/Assets, Stage 4 Scope, Stage 5 Scan Creation and Stage 6 Scan Monitoring, in that order.
